purpose: Decide whether linear-attention architecture earns a roadmap slot in the estate's CPU-lab line. This is an architecture probe, NOT an adoption candidate evaluation. The subject is a 7.5M-parameter micro-model; conclusions apply to the architecture class, not to this artifact's task competence.

governing_boundary.rule: Outputs of any run under this contract are proposal/evidence only. Upstream claims (including the bundled paper.pdf) are not local measurements. Silent substitution is forbidden.

inspected_2026_09_08.note: Research-grade packaging: paper, runnable example, and training config ship in-repo, which makes the probe mechanically reproducible.

execution_envelope.environment: house CPU lab (artifact is CPU-targeted by design; 15MB weights impose no metal requirement)

measurements_required.definition: Decode tok/s and peak RSS at context lengths [512, 2048, 8192, 32768] on the house CPU lab
measurements_required.hypothesis: Memory growth is materially sub-quadratic with context length (the linear-attention claim under test)
measurements_required.label: MEASURED only when produced on estate-controlled hardware

measurements_required.definition: Identical measurements on a comparable transformer-class artifact of similar parameter scale, same hardware, same harness
measurements_required.label: MEASURED; COMPARATIVE, not evaluative

measurements_required.definition: Fixed probe prompts at 2048+ context; outputs reviewed for basic coherence (not gibberish, not looping)
measurements_required.label: SANITY check only; explicitly NOT a quality or reasoning evaluation

measurements_required.definition: Load time, RSS at load, dependency footprint of the shipped requirements.txt
measurements_required.label: MEASURED

decision_rule.earn_roadmap_slot: Memory scaling is materially sub-quadratic through 32768 context AND coherence_sanity passes AND no license or supply-chain defect surfaces
decision_rule.park: Any leg fails; record the failing measurement in the receipt and park the class with the evidence attached
decision_rule.note: A roadmap slot means the class may be considered when a future lane needs long-context CPU inference. It does not select, promote, or ship anything.

non_goals: No Hugging Face repository is created, overwritten, or retagged by this contract
No held frontier choice is promoted or ungated
No claim is made about reasoning capability at any scale
No production use of the subject artifact is authorized
No figure from paper.pdf may be quoted as a local measurement

receipt_requirement.signing_note: Receipts emit under current signing posture; HMAC PLACEHOLDER labeling applies until A11OY_HMAC_KEY is set, per HONEST_DISCLOSURE.md

provenance.radar: frontier-radar-2026-09-07 (contact 1, WATCH tier; parameter count corrected 2026-09-08: 7.5M micro-model, signal-not-candidate)
